notes.title: Patch 1.2.4 Notes
notes.notes:
I think we are overdue for an update to Rustbucket Rumble.  Today's patch adds some cool new stuff and fixes some of the most painful bugs.

First off: HATS!  You can now outfit your robots with a hat to make sure they are looking good.  Some hats can be earned by leveling up, while others can be bought on Steam.  Hit the Customize button on the main menu and find a look that suits you!

We've also changed the way free characters work.  Previously, all players had access to the same 2 free characters each week.  This led to games where only those two characters were present, which gets boring pretty quickly.  We've changed it so that each player gets 2 different free characters each week.  So I may have Clancy and Kasumi this week, but you may have Bjorn and Valentina.  We hope that this change will create much more variety in team comps and more interesting matches.

Let us know what you think of the changes in the comments!

New Content / Features 

Added a Customize button to the main menu.
Added 2 hats as rewards for reaching level 15 and 35.
Added 4 hats that are available for purchase.
Each player now gets a different 2 free characters each week.

Visual Polish

Kasumi's Clones now throw smoke bombs when they vanish.
Team Scraps are now filled with gold to make them more visually distinct from stunned robots.
Made the Giant Robot's distance from the camera more consistent across the different maps.

Bug Fixes

Kasumi's Teleport no longer fails if grounded on the Scrap Yard.
The Giant Robot won't eat things that are held by Robots or Carry Drones.
Scraps don't stay invisible if a Kasumi player disconnects while carrying them.
Bjorn can't Throw people through the roof of the Foundry anymore.
Restored the ability to invite friends to Custom Games.
Made some minor performance improvements.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0 Notes
notes.notes:
Notes for the smaller patch 1.1.2
Patch 1.1.2 is very tiny.  All it changed was the way we help clients find the servers to connect to.

Notes for the smaller patch 1.1.1
We just pushed a very small change for patch 1.1.1.  This patch resolved 2 pesky networking issues:

Fixed a bug that could prevent newcomers from joining existing lobbies when using the Play Now button.
Fixed a bug that made it impossible to start a custom game if the host left before character select.


Notes for the larger patch 1.1.0
Hey there, Rustbucket Rumblers!

Today we deployed patch 1.1.0, which has major changes to the way we handle networking, as well as a few other things.

Before today's patch, each match was hosted by one of the players, and the other players in the match connected to that person's machine.  This meant that we (the developers) didn't have a lot of control over the connection quality, as it varied greatly with the selected host's network configuration.

But as of patch 1.1.0, we have special dedicated servers located across the globe!  Now we can guarantee that the machine hosting the match will be easy to connect to and have a fast upload speed.  That means fewer failed connections, fewer disconnections, and less lag.

Here are the full patch notes:

Networking

Dedicated Servers across the globe!

Balance Changes

Giant Robot health recovered now 100 hp per point scored (was 250 per bin recycled)
Giant Robot healing aura now 3 hp / second (down from 5 hp / second)
Giant Robot undistracted time now 3 seconds (down from 4 seconds)

Bug Fixes

Gameplay related achievements are no longer earned during a tutorial.
Tutorials no longer end immediately if played after a ranked game.

Miscellaneous

Additional information now provided about number of players found when searching for a game.
Connection strength UI is now a bit more forgiving about what it considers a good connection, as we found gameplay was not as sensitive to lag as we originally anticipated.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.11 Notes
notes.notes:
Hey there, Rustbucket Rumblers!

Patch 1.0.11 was deployed this morning.  This patch has some improvements to networking and host selection as well as badge rewards for leveling up.

We've heard your feedback loud and clear that connection issues are a real pain.  This patch contains a number of improvements that we wanted to get live as quickly as possible.  That said, we're not done yet.  We're still actively working on the networking experience, so you can look forward to seeing even more improvements in the future.

Okay, enough chatter.  Here are the actual patch notes:

New Content / Features

 Added three new badges as rewards for reaching level 10, 25, and 50.
 Added a Store button to the main menu.
 Updated the layout of the post game screens to provide more information.

Networking

 Improved host selection when using the Play Now button.
 Reduced message spam when searching for a game.
 Disconnected players' stats now appear in the stats screen.
 Return to the Match Lobby screen if a player drops at character select.
 Game ends instantly if all opponents drop from a ranked game.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue with Kasumi being stuck in carry mode.
 Fixed a bug that could prevent Bjorn's Inescapable Rage achievement from being earned.
